text:
jamal: heads-up — noticed an uptick in 5xxs for runtime:v3.2 when clients using sdk-client 2.9 hit batched embed endpoints. Thinking we should soft-pin SDK to 2.8 for US regions while we investigate.

tara: Do we have a repro? Which endpoints and approximate traffic impact?

jamal: repro attached from perf-run-1791: batch_size=32 embeds API; error surface ~0.6% -> normally 0.02%. Affected region: us-west primarily. Sample trace: 
```
Trace: EmbedBatcherOverflowError at embed/batcher.cpp:227
Client: sdk-client/2.9
Payload: batch=32 seq=1024 model=embed-lite-v1
```

kevin: If it's SDK-related a global SDK pin feels heavy. Can we limit to us-west and to embed routes only? Deploy-bot can create PIN scope by region+route, right?

deploy-bot: command: `/deploy pin add --component sdk-client --version 2.8 --scope region:us-west,route:embeds --reason "embed batch 5xx with sdk 2.9"`

qa-bot: Running smoke tests on embed routes in us-west. Will post results in ~15m.

lina: vote: prefer scoped pin (region+route) + immediate monitor window. Global pin would force many customers to pin config which is noisy.

jamal: agreed. I'll open the hold and add owners: @jamal,@tara. Also want a short rollback playbook in case routing/pinning causes regressions.

deploy-bot: pin created 'sdk-pin-179111' (owners=[jamal,tara], scope=region:us-west;route:embeds; version=2.8). Will block sdk 2.9 traffic to embeds route in us-west for new sessions.

kevin: what's the plan for release notes and console messaging? Even a scoped pin should surface to Dedicated customers. We should auto-generate a console banner: "Scoped SDK pin active for embeds in US-WEST; doing investigation"

jamal: will draft a note. Also we need triage tasks:
- reproduce root cause with SDK 2.9 on a dev cluster (jamal)
- diff 2.8 vs 2.9 batching logic (tara)
- test rollback path and monitor alerting (kevin)

qa-bot: smoke tests complete: embeds route in us-west passing after pin applied; error rate dropped to baseline in canary nodes. No regressions observed in unrelated routes.

lina: good. How long do we keep the pin? propose 12h observation then reevaluate. Add a scheduled check-in at +12h.

jamal: fine. Also want to ensure we have a safe unpin checklist:
1) root cause identified and patch/shim or SDK revert available
2) canary runs green for 6h post-change
3) release notes + ops runbook updated

tara: on the SDK side I found an aggressive buffer pool change in 2.9 (pool reuse across batches) that could underflow on some interleavings. I can prototype a fix and a shim that restores previous pool semantics.

kevin: If we ship a shim, how do we validate without crossing customer traffic? Suggest: apply shim in canary, run canary repro, then unpin region to let 2.9+shim flow for a small percentage (1-2%) before global unpin.

deploy-bot: scheduled check-in reminder `pin-check sdk-pin-179111` at 1791116400 (+12h). Pin will not auto-expire. Manual release required: `/deploy pin release sdk-pin-179111 --by <owner>`

jamal: sounds good. One more note: if we can't produce a fix in 6-8h, we should consider a temporary regression window (overnight) to broaden the pin to all regions to avoid customer impact. That requires approvals from eng-sre and product.

lina: ack; please ping product if that escalation is needed.

kevin: adding monitoring thresholds to the runbook: abort unpin if embed 5xx >0.1% or p95 latency increase >30% for 10m.

tara: opened PR with a shim prototype: `sdk-client#501` — includes unit test for the batch interleave case. CI passing on linux/amd64. link: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-client/pull/501

jamal: after tara's CI green, I'll deploy shim to canary cluster `us-canary-02` and run the failing workload. Report back here.

qa-bot: canary run with shim completed: failing workload now stable on canary; errors zeroed out for 1h.

kevin: recommend staged rollout: 1) remove pin for us-canary only (allow 2.9+shim), monitor 30m. 2) if green, unpin us-west and enable 2.9+shim at 5% traffic, monitor 2h. 3) full unpin.

lina: agree to that plan. Who's owner for the staged rollout?

jamal: I'll own the rollout and monitoring. tara will own the shim PR and QA. kevin will own rollback automation.

deploy-bot: status at 1791112800: pin 'sdk-pin-179111' active; owners=[jamal,tara]; scope=region:us-west,route:embeds; version=2.8. Next scheduled event: pin-check reminder at 1791116400.

kevin: documenting final note for release log: "Temporary scoped pin to SDK 2.8 for embeds in US-WEST due to batch pooling regression in 2.9. Mitigated by scoped pin + SDK shim; staged unpin plan in progress."

jamal: thanks all — posting retrospective once we finish unpin. If anything changes, update this thread. :white_check_mark:
